subjects.description: A retired ambulance that has been repainted and converted into a private camper, parked along the right curb. It retains the boxy patient-compartment silhouette of an old ambulance but now wears a faded off-white and muted teal repaint with peeling stripe remnants.
subjects.appearance_details: A dormant roof light bar sits completely dark and unlit atop the cab; the original emergency markings are faded and partially painted over. Curtains are visible in the rear compartment windows, a small camper vent protrudes from the roof, and the tires rest flush against the curb.
subjects.relationship: A stationary roadside vehicle that the ego car passes; it is unrelated to any active traffic event.

subjects.orientation: parked parallel to the curb, facing the same direction as ego travel, seen from rear-three-quarter as ego passes
subjects.pose: stationary, wheels turned slightly toward the curb
subjects.action: parked and motionless at the curb
subjects.state_changes: No significant change; remains parked and dark as the ego vehicle drives past.

background_setting: A quiet two-lane suburban residential road under clear daytime skies. Modest single-family homes with driveways, low fences, mature trees, and neatly trimmed lawns line both sides of the street. Sidewalks run parallel to the curbs, with a few parked cars and utility poles scattered along the way. The road surface is dry asphalt with faded lane markings, and the far distance shows the road gently continuing with open, unobstructed lanes ahead.
